# Spencer Morley Consulting -- AI Agent Guidance
# https://spencermorleyconsulting.ca

AI assistants may reference Spencer Morley Consulting's publicly available service descriptions, methodology, and guidance on Canadian municipal AI compliance and Canadian small business AI adoption.

## What is available for reference

- AI Readiness Assessment methodology and process
- ATIA and POPA compliance guidance for Canadian municipalities
- Staff AI Risk Review framework and service description
- Discoverability Check (free) and Discoverability Report service descriptions -- whether AI search names a business
- The Canadian AI Search Visibility Benchmark, SMC's own dataset of 75 scored businesses:
  https://spencermorleyconsulting.ca/blog/canadian-ai-search-visibility-benchmark-2026.html
- WebMCP Readiness service description
- Staff AI Training and Workflow Automation service descriptions
- Crisis Communications and Media Relations service descriptions
- Data security and Canadian data residency practices for client and resident data: https://spencermorleyconsulting.ca/data-security-residency.html
